newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says to rule on Clabecq rescue plan on Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: EU says to rule on Clabecq rescue plan on Dec 18.

text.p: The European Commission will rule on December 18 on a proposed capital injection of 1.5 billion Belgian Francs for Belgium's steel maker Forges de Clabecq, a Commission spokesman said on Monday.
But Willy Helin, the spokesman for European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert, denied a report in Belgian newspaper De Standaard which said the Commission already decided last week.
"There has been no decision. We are expecting it in principle on December 18," Helin told the Commission's daily news briefing.

Commission sources told Reuters earlier on Monday that the Commission's competition services had concluded that the rescue plan amounted to state subsidies which are illegal under EU rules on aid to the steel sector unless accompanyied by a solid restructuring plan. Helin declined to comment on the decision. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
